description: B96 — 极限协调施压：对攻中的子力分工

intro.popup_en:
Piece Coordination, Practice 10
The Sicilian Najdorf creates an extreme coordination challenge. Bg5, f4, and Qf3 form an attacking trio, with each piece assigned a clear role.
intro.popup:
子力协调第10局
西西里纳伊多夫：对攻局面的极限协调
Bg5，f4，Qf3三子协调攻击——每子分工明确

outro.popup_en: Summary: coordination in a sharp attack is the highest test. Every piece contributes to the attack; none is idle.
outro.popup:
总结：对攻中的协调是最高境界
每一子都在同时执行攻击任务，无一废子

moves.popup:
e4开局
王翼控制
moves.popup_en: e4 opens the game and establishes a foothold in the center.

moves.popup:
c5！西西里防御
黑方不对称反击
moves.popup_en: ...c5! The Sicilian Defense creates an asymmetrical counterattack.

moves.popup: Nf3第1马
moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops White's first knight.

moves.popup: d6黑方守中心
moves.popup_en: ...d6 reinforces Black's center.

moves.popup:
d4！打开中心
激活：打开d列，让Nf3进入d4
moves.popup_en: d4! White opens the center and clears a route for the knight from f3 to d4.

moves.popup:
cxd4黑方换兵
西西里的核心：打开c列
moves.popup_en: ...cxd4 exchanges pawns and opens the c-file, a central idea in the Sicilian.

moves.popup:
Nxd4马进中心
激活：马控c2/b3/f3/e6
计划：Nxd4是白方中心的核心
moves.popup_en: Nxd4 centralizes the knight, which influences c2, b3, f3, and e6. It is a key part of White's central setup.

moves.popup:
Nf6黑方马出动
攻击e4
moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops and attacks e4.

moves.popup:
Nc3第2马
协调：Nxd4+Nc3双马控制中心
计划：后翼子力控中，王翼开始攻击！
moves.popup_en: Nc3 develops the second knight. Together, the two knights control the center, allowing White to prepare a kingside attack.

moves.popup:
a6防止Nb5
黑方典型的纳伊多夫标志
moves.popup_en: ...a6 prevents Nb5 and is a characteristic Najdorf move.

moves.popup:
Bg5！攻击三角第1支柱！
激活：象出动牵制Nf6
协调：Bg5（牵制f6马）是白方攻击体系的"第一刀"
任务：限制黑方f6马的活动，使黑方防守被动
moves.popup_en: Bg5! The first part of White's attacking trio. The bishop pins Nf6 and restricts a key defender, making Black's defense less flexible.

moves.popup:
e6黑方守备
黑方开放e线，Be7解救Nf6
moves.popup_en: ...e6 reinforces Black's position and opens a route for ...Be7 to help the knight on f6.

moves.popup:
f4！攻击三角第2支柱！
激活：f4兵推进
协调：f4（推进控e5/准备f5）+ Bg5（牵制）联动
任务：f4→f5的推进是王翼攻击的主轴！
moves.popup_en: f4! The second part of the attacking trio. The pawn controls e5 and prepares f5, working with the bishop's pin to build the kingside attack.

moves.popup:
Be7黑方象出动
黑方解救Nf6
moves.popup_en: ...Be7 develops the bishop and helps free Nf6 from the pin.

moves.popup:
Qf3！攻击三角第3支柱！
激活：后出来支援
协调三角完成：
  Bg5（牵制f6马）
  f4（f列推进轴）
  Qf3（后支援f5+威胁Bxf6）
三角协调攻击形成！
计划：后+象+f兵，三子同时施压黑方
moves.popup_en: Qf3 completes the attacking trio. Bg5 pins Nf6, f4 prepares the pawn advance, and the queen supports f5 while also threatening Bxf6. Three pieces now pressure Black together.

moves.popup:
Qc7黑方后联结双车
黑方准备后翼反击
moves.popup_en: ...Qc7 connects Black's rooks and prepares queenside counterplay.

moves.popup:
O-O-O！长易位！
激活：双车控d/e列
协调：长易位后Rd1控d列
计划：后翼控制（Nd4+Nc3+Rd1）+王翼攻击（Bg5+f4+Qf3）
双翼协调并进！这是极限协调的最高形式！
moves.popup_en: O-O-O! White castles long, activating the rooks on the d- and e-files. The queenside pieces control the center while Bg5, f4, and Qf3 attack on the kingside: coordinated play on both wings.

moves.popup:
Nbd7黑方第2马出动
准备后翼反击
moves.popup_en: ...Nbd7 develops Black's second knight and supports the queenside counterattack.

moves.popup:
g4！翼兵推进！
激活：g4开启g列攻击
协调：g4+f4双兵推进
任务：g4→g5，逼黑方Nf6离开防守位
moves.popup_en: g4! White advances a flank pawn to open the g-file. Together with f4, it supports a two-pawn attack and may drive Nf6 away from its defensive post.

moves.popup:
b5！黑方后翼反击！
协调对抗：黑方在后翼推进回应白方王翼攻击
这就是对攻：双方协调各自的攻击！
moves.popup_en: ...b5! Black counterattacks on the queenside in response to White's kingside assault. Both sides coordinate their attacks on opposite wings.

moves.popup:
Bxf6！！消除Nf6！
激活：象换马，清除黑方关键防守子
协调：Bg5的任务完成——牵制后再消除
计划：换掉Nf6后，g5推进无阻挡！
moves.popup_en: Bxf6!! The bishop completes its task by exchanging itself for Black's key defender. After pinning Nf6, it removes the knight so g5 may advance with less resistance.

moves.popup:
Nxf6黑方吃回
黑方Nd7跳入f6补位
moves.popup_en: ...Nxf6 recaptures, with the knight from d7 replacing the captured defender.

moves.popup:
f5！！主轴突破！
激活：f5兵打开e6守备
协调：f4→f5是白方攻击体系的最终一击
  Qf3（支援f5推进）
  g4（配合f5，双兵联进）
  Rd1（车控d列，随时增援）
计划：f5强行打开e6，也同时消除了黑方e6兵对d5的控制！
moves.popup_en: f5!! White launches the main breakthrough. Qf3 supports the advance, g4 joins the attack, and the rook on d1 can reinforce. The push opens e6 and removes Black's control of d5.

moves.popup:
exf5黑方被迫吃回
黑方e6兵吃f5，中心被强行打开
✅ 重要：e6空了！白方d5崁子不再被吃！
moves.popup_en: ...exf5 is forced. Black's e6-pawn captures, opening the center and vacating e6; White's knight can now use d5 without being captured by that pawn.

moves.popup:
gxf5！g兵吃回！
激活：g4兵加入攻击航线
协调：g落在f5，f列+g列将全面开放
现在e6已空，d5格安全无忧！
moves.popup_en: gxf5! The g-pawn joins the attack and recaptures on f5. The f- and g-files may open, while the cleared e6-square makes d5 safer for White's knight.

moves.popup:
O-O黑方易位
黑方国王认为逃到安全区，但实际上走入了白方攻击范围！
moves.popup_en: ...O-O brings Black's king to the kingside, but that is where White's attack is gathering.

moves.popup:
Nd5！！马占领中心强格！
激活：Nc3跳入d5——完美中心格！
✅ e6已空，Nd5安全不被吃！
协调：Nd5（进攻型、攻击Qc7）+ Qf3（支援）+ Rd1（车控d列）
黑方Qc7被头马攻击，必须撤退！
moves.popup_en: Nd5!! The knight from c3 occupies an ideal central outpost. With e6 cleared, it cannot be captured by the e-pawn. Supported by Qf3 and Rd1, it attacks Qc7 and forces the queen to move.

moves.popup:
Qd8黑后被迫撤退
黑方后失去主动权，守备被动
moves.popup_en: ...Qd8 retreats the queen, leaving Black on the defensive.

moves.popup:
Nxf6+！！马吃马将军！
激活：Nd5跳入f6，吃掉黑方马并将军！
协调终结态：
♞ Nxf6+（马吃马并将军）
♟ f5（兵打开中心）
♖ Rd1（车控d列）
♛ Qf3（后遥控全局）
✅ Bg5（消除Nf6）→f4+g4（双兵打基）→f5（突破e6）→Nd5（马占中心）→Nxf6+（最终一击）
这是最极限的协调攻击体系！
moves.popup_en: Nxf6+!! The knight from d5 captures Black's knight with check. White's coordinated finish combines the f5 pawn breaking open the center, Rd1 controlling the d-file, and Qf3 supporting the attack. The sequence is complete: Bg5 pins, f4 and g4 prepare the assault, f5 breaks through, Nd5 occupies the center, and Nxf6+ delivers the final blow.
